title: Queue parked row state labels
summary: Stop labeling normal parked CSV rerun rows as Review in the Queue table and selected-row status surfaces.
reason: Parked review-workspace and Pending Publish CSV rerun rows are normal parked-output states, not per-file problem rows. Showing every parked row as Review made the Queue table noisy and hid the rows that actually need operator review.
behavior_before: CSV rerun review-workspace rows were exported with operator_status_state=review/operator_severity=warning, Pending Publish rows were warning-like, and the WebView table collapsed parked states into a Review chip. Normal parked rows could also be counted as hidden review rows in WebView filter guidance.
behavior_after: CSV rerun review-workspace and Pending Publish rows are exported as operator_status_state=parked/operator_severity=ok. The Queue table renders parked/review-workspace rows as Parked and pending-publish rows as Pending Publish, while true warning/review/blocked rows still render as Review or Blocked.
